description: This source file defines an Android ListActivity called List8, which displays a list of photos using a custom adapter. The activity demonstrates setEmptyView functionality and includes buttons to add and clear photos. The inner class PhotoAdapter manages a list of photo resource IDs, providing methods to add and clear images, and creates ImageViews for each item.

classes.name: List8
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that displays photos in a list, with buttons to add and remove photos. Uses a custom adapter and setEmptyView functionality.

classes.name: PhotoAdapter
classes.description: Inner class extending BaseAdapter to display a dynamic list of photo images. Supports adding and removing photos, and creates ImageViews for each list item.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, configures empty view, sets up adapter, and binds button click listeners.

methods.name: clearPhotos
methods.description: Clears the photo list and refreshes the view.

methods.name: addPhotos
methods.description: Adds a random photo from the pool to the list and updates the view.
